raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 27 txn_ids that appear twice, once as record_version 1 and once as record_version 2. silver_transactions keeps both versions because it only filters on status, so each duplicated transaction is counted twice in silver and in every gold table. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter should yield one correct row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) x WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
